tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i gsal byed rin po che'i do shal bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la sa ba ri wa re bh+ya/ dge legs in+d+ra ṇī la'i sa 'dzin ngos/ nyin byed 'od kyi phung po cher gsal bzhin/ /shin tu brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur khro bo'i sku/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshogs la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rim gnyis lam gyi gzhir gyur smin byed kyi/ /cho ga 'khrul med brgyud pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /gsal bar brjod la dang bas mnyan par bgyi/ /'dir dpal rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas rang gzhan smin par byed pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ dang po la gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ sa'i cho ga sta gon du gnas pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid ston pa ste/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje las rim dang / rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar blta'o/ /gnyis pa gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang / gzhung de dag tu gsal bas 'dir ma brjod do/ /gsum pa sa'i cho ga la bdun/ sa gzhi bslang ba/ sa brtag pa/ sa sbyang ba/ byin gyis brlab pa/ sa sta gon bya ba/ sa bzung ba/ srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ dang po ni/ snang ba las bslang ba sogs dgos na'ang gzhung bzhin bya zhing / mi snang ba las blang ba ni/ gang du 'os pa'i sar me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i khar man ji btsugs la/ de'i steng du dpal chen po'i gtor ma bshams/ mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rnams 'khor mar bshams la/ byang shar du sa'i lha mo'i dgos mchod/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ gtor ma gcig rnams dang / gzhan yang bsrung ma'i gtor ma sogs ji ltar dgos pa dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod/ bsnyen phur dang /

'og tu dgos pa'i gdab phur bcu la/ yungs dkar gyi thum bu dang / dar gyis cod pan btags pa gu gul/ dri bzang dang chang bsres pa/ rnga/ cha lang / dung la sogs pa yo byad thams cad tshang bar 'dus byas la/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis chus sbyangs/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum 'tshal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ rat+na bhañdza/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum gyis phul nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ /nas/ ci bde bar ni gzhan du song / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / 'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs pa bgyid na/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad zhi ba dang / dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sogs brjod/ gnyis pa sa brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa rnams su mi dgos la/ dgos pa'i sar dkyil chog bzhin bya'o/

gsum pa sa sbyang ba la sngon du/ mchod pa byin rlabs sta gon bzhin byas te/ rnga byin dbab rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ mngon rtogs 'bring bsdus skabs dang sbyar te/ bzlas pa yan tshar ba dang srung ma'i gtor ma rnams phul la/ mngon rtogs 'bring po byas na dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ sa sbyang ba dngos la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dang po ni/ rang gi mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma ram gyis mtshan pa/ g.yon pa a las zla ba las mtshan pa/ hūm̐ g.yas pa'i spyan zur la gnas pa'i/ ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyi snang ba'i dngos po kun/ thams cad ma lus bsregs par bya/ mā sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la da ha da ha bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las byung ba yi/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis/ dngos kun bsregs pa'i thal ba yang / thams cad ma lus gtor bar bya/ yaṃ bā yu maṇ+ḍa la bha k+ṣa re ṇu ku ru/ g.yon pa'i spyan zur las byung ba'i/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyis snang ba'i dngos po kun/ thams cad ma lus bkru bar bya/ ā tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la snā na ku ru oṃ shū n+ya tā sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gnyis pa nang gi sbyang ba ni/ sna tshogs 'di dag 'khrul pa la snang yang don dam par ni chos kyi dbyings nyid do/ /oṃ dharmā dhā tu sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gsum pa gsang ba'i sbyang ba ni/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma as mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yab kyi gsang gnas yum gyi mkhar babs pa sa gzhi la thim pas/

bde ba chen po'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe bhā wan+tu/ bzhi pa sa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar gyi tshom bu la dmigs te/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ṭa la/ zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i gdan du gyur/ bdag gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas/ sa 'di lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang gyur gshegs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing / thal mo g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa lan gsum la reg ngag tu sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo mthon/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mdog ser mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rnal 'byor bka' stsal ji ltar bgyi zhes smra ba/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ nas/ badz+ra bi pu ra ye hūm̐ gi bar dang / gtor ma sbyangs la 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ pri thi wī la a kā ro btags pas phul/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ shākya seng ge skyob pa yis sogs nas/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs nas/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs pa bgyid na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang bstsal du gsol/ /khyod ni slob dpon dam pa yin/ /sems can don phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī badz+ra mu/ lha mos de nyid du thim pas gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ zhes brjod la/ mchod gtor tshom bu dman pa rnams gzhan du bsal lo/ /lnga pa sa sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sa la sngar gyi dri bzang dang / chang bsres pas byugs cing / hūm̐ chos dbyings dag pa'i bdud rtsi sogs nas/ gur las me 'od 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ drug pa sa bzung ba la/ blo dang stang stabs kyis bzung ba gnyis las/

dang po dkyil chog bzhin/ gnyis pa la gsol ba gdab pa/ bgegs bskrad pa gnyis kyis dang po ni/ slob dpon gtso bo'i mdog dang mthun pa'i chos gos gyon la dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su khri'u chung la khyel byas nas/ shar du gzigs pa'i mdun/ stegs kyi steng du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ nang mchod/ rdor dril bshams te/ phyogs bzhir rnams rgyal la sogs pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ rim pa'am gcig char du mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ nas bi spu ra ya'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas dag pa yis/ /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la ban+dha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes pas nang mchod dang / bstod pa dang / gsol btab dkyil chog ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa la/ byin gyis brlab pa/ bka' bsgo ba/ stang stabs dngos dang gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐/ zhes pas gtso bo'i nga rgyal bzung la/ rang gi mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ g.yon pa a las zla ba as mtshan pa/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsaṇ+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje re re bsam la/ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra/ g.yas g.yon spyan zur ma a las/ byung ba'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las/ spros pa'i 'od kyis bgegs tshogs kun/ thams cad ma lus bskrad par bya/ badz+ra tṛṣ+ṭa ma a/ g.yas g.yon spyan zur ma a las/ byung ba'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las/ spros pa'i rdo rje rab 'bar bas/ phyogs kun rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/

kro dha tṛṣ+ṭi ma a/ gnyis pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ dbang ldan nas dbus su zhal phyogs pas rdo rje gsor dril bu sil zhing / gzhan yang rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ zhes pa nas/ mgo nas brgyab nas rting par 'gems/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod la/ kī la ya bzlas/ yung dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug hūm̐ gi sgra drag tu bsgrags la/ nyi ma zla ba rdo rje las 'od zer byung bas gdug pa can rnams bsregs bcom/ lhag ma rnams gzhan du byer bar bsam mo/ /gsum pa stang stabs kyi bkod pas sa bzung ba ni/ rgyas par na/ skabs 'dir shes rab snang bas mdzad pa'i 'cham dpe lus 'gyur snang ba bzhin/ rtsa 'cham rdzogs par bya zhing / mdor bsdu na/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ oṃ hūm̐ chen ka ra'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis thar sbyar gyen du bsgreng / /rkang gnyis mthil sbyar thur du zug /tshigs chen bzhi yang bcag par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis thugs khar bsnol byas nas/ /mche ba gtsigs shing zhal bsgrad pa/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya sogs/ /dbyug pa sngon po'i phyag rgya ni/ /g.yon pas sku la brten nas ni/ /g.yas pa'i mdzub dang gung gnyis bsgreng / /'debs pa'i tshul du byas pa yin/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la sogs/ /gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya ni/ /g.yas pa gdengs shing khu tshur bcangs/ /g.yon pa dku la brten nas ni/ /g.yas pa gdengs shing khu tshur bcangs/ g.yon pa dku la brten nas ni/ gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka sogs/mi g.yo mgon po'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis spar mo gdengs nas kyang / /g.yon gyi phyogs su 'phyar ba ni/ /mi g.yo mgon po'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badz+ra krodha ār+ya sogs/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i phyag rgya ni/

/lag gnyis spyi bor rgya bcings nas/ /lus po brdungs par bstan pa ni/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sogs/ /gzhan gyi mi thub phyag rgya yin/ lag gnyis spar mo gdeng byas nas/ 'dzin pa'i stabs su byas pa ni/ /gzhan gyi mi thub phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta sogs/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya ni/ lag gnyis dku la brten byas nas/ /rked pa brdungs par bstan pa ni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya yin/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs/ khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya ni/ /g.yas pa dku la brten byas nas/ /g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe chung mnan/ gsum po 'dzin pa lcags kyu'i tshul/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya sogs/ /stobs po che'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis sor mo bsnol nas ni/ /steng nas gnon pa lta bu bya/ /stobs po che'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ /steng dang phyogs kyi khro bo rnams/ /rkang g.yon drang bzhag g.yas nang bskor/ 'og dang mtshams kyi khro bo ni/ g.yon pa nang du bskor bar bya/ /ces pa ltar/ /khro bo rol pa'i stang stabs rnams bya'o/ /bdun pa bsrung ba la gnyis/ phur bu gdab pa dang / srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du 'dus byas pa'i phur bu bcu/ gu gul gyis bdugs te/ /oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ sarba sha trūṃ bighan dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs dang / kī la ya'i rjes la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa brjod cing / yungs kar gyis brab/ phur bu rnams stod khro bo bcu/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra sogs/ khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa mang po spros/ phyogs bcu'i dbang po la sogs pa'i ming gzugs 'dzin pa'i bgegs rnams bkug nas/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du hūm̐ las grub pa'i khron pa bcur bcug par bsam zhing /

phur bu bsgril la/ kī la ya ci rigs bzlas/ slob dpon shar du lta bas/ lag g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang / g.yon phur bu rnams rim pas bzung la/ dzaḥsteng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol pa'i gdan stengs na/ /hūm̐ mdzad dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can/ /zhal nas kī la ya yi sgra sgrogs pas/ /tshangs pa'i gdon rnams bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sogs brjod cing / kī la ya'i 'gros kyis phur bu 'debs tshul bya/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod cing / bsgral mchod kyi rnga bzhin/ drag myur brdungs la phur pa steng du 'debs pa'i tshul gyi stengs ka byas la/ shar du 'dzugs/ de bzhin du shar phyogs dri za bsnol ba'i gdan stengs na/ rnam rgyal dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can/ /zhal༞ dri za'i gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dhā bi dza ya sogs/ shar lhor me lha༞ dbyug sngon༞ zhal༞ me lha'i gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la sogs/ lho phyogs gshin rje༞ gshin rje zhal༞ gshin rje'i gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān ta ka sogs/ lho nub srin po༞ mi g.yo༞ zhal༞ srin po'i gdon/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la sogs/ nub phyogs chu lha༞ rta mgrin༞ zhal༞ chu lha'i gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sogs/ nub byang rlung lha༞ 'dod rgyal༞ zhal༞ rlung lha'i gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra sogs/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin༞ 'khyil pa༞ zhal༞ gnod sbyin gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya sogs/ byang shar bgegs bdag༞ gsum rgyal༞ zhal༞ bgegs bdag gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya sogs/ 'og phyogs sa bdag༞ stobs chen༞ zhal༞ sa bdag gdon༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā ba la sogs brjod cing 'og tu 'debs tshul dang / nub tu btsugs la/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas phur bu btab pas/ rkang mthil du phug ste/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pas lus g.yo 'gul med cing / sems rtog med bde chen gyi ngo bor gyur nas khro bcus bgegs bsrung ba'i las mdzad par bsam/

gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ ces pa nas/ bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /de nas tshogs dbul ba sogs/ rjes chog rnams mngon rtogs 'bring bsdus gang rung bzhin bya ste/ de dag gis ni nub dang po sa'i cho ga'o/ /bzhi pa sta gon la thig gdab pa/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dkyil chog bzhin las kyi thig gi cha dbye ba legs par bya/ gnyis pa lha sta gon la gsum/ lha bskyed pa/ mchod bstod bya ba/ snyan gsan dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni thig btab pa'i lha gnas rnams su dbus su gru bzhi pa/ 'khor rnams la zlum por/ dri bzang gis byug pa'i steng du me tog tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa bkod/ dam can gyi snam bu la phyogs rnams su bdun bdun dang / mtshams rnams su gsum re ste/ bzhi bcu bkod pa'i mthar/ dur khrod kyi steng la chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa 'khor mar bshams/ 'dod snam kyi steng du sgos mchod lha grangs dang mthun pa lag len ltar bshams nas/ ji ltar rigs par gtor ma dang / sman phud dang rak+ta/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod/ bsnyen phur sras mchog lnga/ bum pa bcu drug gam gnyis/ slob ma sta gon dgos na/ de'i yo byad rnams dang / yang stegs gcig tu tshon sna lnga/ dbus su sngon po/ shar dkar lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu la/ dbus nas rim pa bzhin hūm̐ oṃ swā a hā rnams bris/ so so'i mdog dang 'thun pa'i thig skud kyang bkod/ /dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma sa chog gis mi snang ba las slang ba'i skabs ltar btang ste/ gnas dang / mchod pa rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang / 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rjas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dpal kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu zhig bla ma/ yi dam/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ā hā ra li sogs brjod/ rnga byin dbab rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa'i bar sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin byas la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ a mṛ tas bsang / oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā nas/ rdo rje khros pas sogs dang / keṃ ka la sogs phaiṃ/sgra sgrogs pas gang / dzaḥpaṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la nas/ ma traṃ dza'i bar brjod cing / gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed la/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ sgril ma bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum brjod la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su khro bo'i rgyal/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ ces dang / oṃ dip+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ /yum chen 'khor lo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas zhugs/ zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bo yab yum bskyed/ de nas oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra sogs rang sngags brjod la gsal gdab pa ni/ steng gi phyogs kyi gdan steng su/ khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril/ phra thabs bskyed na༞ sprul pa phag dang dmigs bu'i mgo /zhes brjod/ de bzhin 'don pa bsgyur la/ rang sngags brjod cing / shar gyi phyogs kyi gdan stengs su/ /khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ /rdo rje snyems ma sku ma 'khril/

/sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo /me'i mtshams kyi gdan steng su/ /dbyug sngon༞ dbu gsum༞ rdo rje sder mos༞ g.yag dang bya rog༞ lho'i phyogs kyi༞ gshin rje༞ dbu༞ rdo rje dur khrod༞ sha ba 'ug pa༞ lho nub phyogs༞ mi g.yo༞ dbu༞ rdo rje gtun khung༞ gzig dang khwa ta'i༞ nub kyi phyogs༞ rta mgrin༞ dbu༞ rdo rje gtum mos༞ byi bla pu shud༞ nub byang phyogs༞ gzhan gyis mi thub༞ dbu༞ rdo rje mda' snyems༞ lce spyang kha'i༞ byang gi༞ 'khyil pa༞ dbu༞ rdo rje sgra mdzad༞ seng ge pha waṃ༞ byang shar༞ khams gsum rnam rgyal༞ dbu༞ rdo rje gsod byed༞ tred dang sbre mo༞ 'og gi phyogs༞ stobs chen༞ dbu༞ rdo rje rig byed༞ dom dang byi ba'i mgo༞ khro chen yab rnams thams cad ni/ rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pa rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /tha mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/ /yum rnams phyag g.yas dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu po/ /g.yas pas rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pa phur sgril ro steng bzhugs/ /shar sgor pu shud mgo can ni/ /mdog dkar 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu rnams/ /lho sgor bya rog mgo can ni/ /mdog ser 'ching byed zhags pa bsnams/ /nub sgor srin bya'i mgo can ni/ /mdog dmar sdom byed lcags sgrog bsnams/ /byang sgor khra'i mgo can ni/ ljang khu myos byed dril bu bsnams/ /khro chen yab yum thams cad kyang / /rgyan sogs yab yum tshul bzhin te/ /kun kyang rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim khor yug na/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis sogs/ /dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par gyur/ /slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ 'khor ba phur bu sgrub don du sogs sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ a ti pu ho/

pra tipa dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra pā daṃ ban+dha naṃ/ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra hasta tsā pā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi sogs kyis dgug zhug bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ sogs kyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ /thabs kyi spyod pas sogs kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ /'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis rgyas btab/ /gnyis pa mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab te/ rdo rje sgeg mo sogs byed pa'am/ phyag len la/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo yi/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /badz+ra la s+ya nas shab+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun du dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis nang mchod phul/ cung zad rgyas par byed na sgrub thabs 'bring po ltar bya/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen sngags dang bcas pas gsang mchod/ bsgral mchod gdab ka dang po yan dang / he ru ka'i gnas bcu sogs nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ /sgeg cing dpa' dang zhes sogs nas/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i sku ston pa/ /tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ /e ka dza ṭī gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum/ tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/

/dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' bsrung dam can tshogs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /bdag nyid chen po shwa na mu kha dang / /sa bdag chen mo bse'i lha mo bzhi/ /spyi byin yang byin bse byin phag byin ma/ /tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /de nas 'dod chags khros pa'i me sogs nas/ /khong stong byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod la/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ci nus bya/ gsum pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba yi sogs bya/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa rnams 'khyil pas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/kha g.yel ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi dbus dang / phyogs bcu/ de'i phyi'i phyogs bzhi rnams su paṃ las pad+ma dang / am̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ ljang sngon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs kyi bar dang / shar gyi g.yas kyi gdan stengs su/ khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril/ /shar gyi g.yon gyi gdan steng su/ /khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal sogs/ /phra thabs bor la gong bzhin dang / /nub kyi g.yas kyi gdan steng su/ /khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal/ /sogs dang / nub kyi g.yon gyi gdan steng su/

/khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /sogs dang / nub byang 'tshams kyi gdan steng su/ /khro chen gzhan gyi mi thub pa nas/ rdo rje gsod mas sku la 'khril gyis bar dang / khro chen yab rnams thams cad ni/ /nas/ yab la stobs kyi bar dang / shar phyogs su pu shud mgo can ni/ nas/ dril bu bsnams zhes pa'i bar dang / las kyi bum par/ /'khyil pa dkar dmar dbus ljang zhal/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rgya gram be con bsnams/ /tha mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/ /lha mo rdo rje sgrol mdzad ljang / /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis gnyis med sbyor/ /khro chen 'khor bcas yab yum rnams/ nas/ /med dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ /ye shes pa 'khor bcas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā yawā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ /thabs kyi spyod pas sogs kyis dbang bskur/ khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ sgeg phreng glu gar sogs phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i glongs dkyil nas/ /shin tu mi bzad dpal chen he ru ka/ /phyogs bcu khro bo'i tshogs rnams thugs las sprul/ /rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs skyong dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su/ /bdud 'dul mthu chen ye shes khro bo bcu/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi srid gsum 'gro ba sgrol/ /khro rgyal yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byams sogs tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug dang 'dra ba la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi gtong zhing /

/thugs rjes kun la khyab pa'i dbyings su 'khyil/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod la/ pad skor gyis gzung thag blangs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas/ lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bum pa gang bar bsam la/ kī la ya sogs lha bco lnga'i sngags ci rigs pa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brgya rtsa tsam bzlas te/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yi ge brgya pa dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyi bzod gsol bya/ kī la ya brjod cing / dung chos kyi chu blug pas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas/ bsrung gtor rnams phul la/ bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ don bcu gcig gis bsdus pa dkyil chog bzhin las/ byin gyis brlab pa'i dus/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi phung por gyur pa las/ slob dpon gyi kī la ya'i sngags brjod pas skad cig la/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bsam ste/ zhal phyag gsal btab/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ slob ma la phog pas/ dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing kī la ya lan gsum brjod/ dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pa gnas gsum du reg pas yi ge 'bru gsum bsam pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'bru gsum dang 'od zer dkar dmar sngo gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs su gyur par mos pa mdzod byas la/ mchod pas mchod pa sogs dkyus bzhin/ bsrung skud 'ching dus kī la ya dang /

'khyil pa'i sngags/ sarba bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ brjod la/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon pa dang / bud med kyi g.yas su 'ching / gtor ma btang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi'am/ gang yang rung bar gtor ma dang / mchod pa lag len bzhin bshams la/ 'khyil pas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs te/ byin gyis brlab pa nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar cha gsum gyi phyogs skyong gi gtor ma bzhin byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar dang / dpal ldan bla ma sogs kyi phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong rnams sgrub khang gi phyogs bcur 'khod nas/ bar chad bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing / bdud rtsi gnas gsum du reg pas bsrung la/ gtor ma khyer te sa gtsang sar bskyal/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bsor dril bu bsil zhing / kī la ya brjod/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ nang du slebs pa dang / slob dpon gyis yig brgya brjod cing g.yas rdo rje thugs kha dang / g.yon dril bu bcad bstubs su 'khrol zhing / dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor nas shar phyogs su 'greng ste/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs brjod/ sgeg phreng glu gar sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas sogs kyis nang mchod phul nas/ slob ma la rmi lam bzang ngan brtag pa sogs byas la/ rang gnas su btang / tshogs byin gyis rlabs la/ phud dbul ba dang / longs spyad nas/ mchod pa kha gso/ byin rlabs nas/ sgeg phreng bzhi/ rang byung sogs kyis mchod la/ bstod pa sgeg cing dpa' nas/ bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la 'dud/ ces pas bstod/ ye shes lnga ldan gyi dngos grub blang / yig brgya brjod/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rnams sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar/

nam mkhar bzhugs nas dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin/ mchod bstod byas nas/ mdun gyi gtor mgron rnams gshegs gsol dang / brtan bzhugs ci rigs par byas la/ bdag gi dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ go cha bgo ba/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bya/ de nas thig tshon rnams 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan lnga'i dbus su dbang phyug yab yum/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin gyis gdan/ skad cig gis gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭa kyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+ma ko3haṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas/ yum gyi mkhar thig ler babs pa/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ahā lhar gyur pa yum gyi mkha' nas/ gdan stengs su babs te/ zhu ba las sras mchog rigs lnga'i skur gyur pa ni/ dbus su badz+ra kī la ya/ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum bsnams/ g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gi bsnams/ mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ shar du bud+dha kī la ya/ smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje rtse dgu 'khor lo dang / /lho ru rat+na kī la ya/ /ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rin chen dang / nub tu pad+ma kī la ya/ dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje rtse dgu pad+ma dang / /byang du karma kī la ya/ /ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rgya gram dang / /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ /kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/

ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra kī la ya pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ badz+ra ā ha ra sogs kyis mchod/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma badz+ra sa mā ya hūm̐ aḥ zhes pas tshon dang oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya su tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ ces pas/ thig byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags gnyis nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas/ slar yang / thig 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab la/ ye thig dang / tshon bkra brtag pa sogs dkyil chog bzhin no/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la gsum/ dkyil 'khor bri ba/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o/ bri ba la gnyis/ mtshan ma 'god pa/ rgyan bgram pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas phur pa bsnams nas rang rang gi phyogs su bkod la/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhin skyabs su 'gro ba dang / tshad med bzhi byas/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya dang / oṃ dharma dha tu sogs/ rdo rje khros pas sogs nas/ rang gtso bo yab yum yan lag bzhi rjes su bskyed pa yan chad yang snying lhan skyes ltar byas la/ phur pa a mṛ tas bsang / oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ yungs kar dang / rak+ṣa gtor/ gu gul gyis bdugs la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs brjod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ kyi bar dang / oṃ dī sta tsakra sogs/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sogs nas/ g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs kyi bar dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /zhes sogs brjod pa dang mnyam tu phur bu rnams lha de dang de'i ngo bor krong gis bskyed/ sgo ma'i bar sngags brjod pa dang gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/

/zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ yo gī shwa rī aṣ+ṭa biṃ shwa ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dha ti ma mashrī gh+raṃ karma kā ra mā ra se na pra marda ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /bka' yis srungs ma dam can bcu gnyis sogs/ /rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ ye shes pa 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gnas rnams su/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la nas/ ma traṃ dza'i bar brjod pas gdan rnams mngon rtogs bzhin skye/ gtso phur thogs la/ hūm̐ dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha sogs/ dkyil chog bzhin phur pa bkod/ khor yug gi phur pa bkod dus/ gong gi rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / sogs kyi rjes su/ dam tshig dgongs shing rang rang gdan la bzhugs/ gong gi sngags kyi mjug tu/ ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pas bkod/ gnyis pa rgyan dgram pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mda' dar bcu/ steng dang logs su tshon skud kyi dra ba/ gzhan yang bla bre/ yol ba/ 'phan gdugs sogs kyis mdzes par bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i nang gra bzhir 'byor na bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa bzhi'i steng du thod pa'am/ nya phyis kyi nang du bdud rtsi blug pa yang bshams/ ma 'byor na bum thod kyi gzugs bris pas kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa la gsum/ tho 'dzugs pa/ bum pa 'god pa/ lhag chad bskang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang ngam/ phyi rol gang yang rung bar/ rgyal chen gyi sku tsa ka li'am/ 'bur dod gang rung bzhugs su bcug med na phyogs bzhir tho btsugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod gtor khyer la/ thog mar shar gyi mchod gtor/

a mṛr tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i snod du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra sogs brjod/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ zhes sogs lan gsum bya/ swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dhṛṃ las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung ljang khu/ phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bsgrengs shing dar dang / rin po ches brgyan pa/ dri za'i tshogs kyi bskor ba sogs dkyil chog bzhin spyan 'dren/ mchod pa/ gtor ma bstod pa rnams tshigs bcad la/ rnga brdungs/ gzhan rnams shar ma bya te/ lho phyogs sogs 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa 'god pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang / mchod g.yog pas las bum thogs/ spos kyis sna grangs/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas la/ slob dpon gyis gtso bo'i sngags brjod cing / rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes brjod nas/ gtso bo dang lha'i gnas rnams su bum pa 'bul ba'i stangs ka byas la/ rang gi spyi bor gtugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bzhag las bum bzung la 'khyil sngags brjod cing / khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol zhes dang / lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas la/ byang shar du bzhag go /gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ rol mo dang bcas bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor nas/ yig brgya brjod/ /shar phyogs su 'grengs te/ ma 'byor ba nas/ lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol gyi bar brjod la/ gsol ba btab pa ni/ chos dbyings dag pa'i sogs lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' dri bzang gi chus byugs la/

mchod gtor rnams/ sta gon las mi nyung bar lag len bzhin bshams la/ slob dpon grogs dang bcas pa gral la 'khod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / mchod pa byin rlabs rnga byin dbab nas bzung ste/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi/ hūm̐ de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs dang / dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal sogs kyis bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi bzlas pa dang / rig 'dzin bskul ba yan chad sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin nyams su blangs la/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol du mchod gtor bshams la/ bsang sbyangs nas phrin las bcol te/ kī la ya brjod cing / gtor ma skyel ba sogs/ slob ma sta gon bzhin bya/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du slebs nas yig brgya bzlas shing bskor ba dang / bzod gsol gong bzhin byas nas/ sgrub mchod zhag kha yar byed na nub phyi ma rnams la chos dbyings dag pa sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ nub snga ma la/ bum pa dbul ba'i rjes su gsol btab grub pas 'dir mi dgos/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad 'dus byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi dbang bskur thob pa'i slob dpon du mos la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi khrus byas nas/ spro ba dri ba sogs cho ga phal cher 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya zhing / cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bsgrag pa mi brjod/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul dus/ dang po dang / tha ma la tshig rgyas pa brjod cing /

gzhan rnams la maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig sogs kyis dbul dbang rdzas rdo dril/ dbu rgyan bum pa tsam ma rtogs/ gzhan rnams yid kyi bya zhing / 'og rigs lnga'i chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang gi skabs su so so'i phyag rgya 'cha'/ sngags kyi bzlas lung mi dgos/ de nas bsrung gtor rnams phul la/ bskang ba dang bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la 'jug pa dang / dbang dngos/ dang po la/ phyi nang gnyis kyi/ phyi la spro ba dri ba/ bu tshur dang / skal bzang sogs dkyus bzhin/ bden pa brjod pa/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas langs te/ chos rnams sogs brjod/ chas zhugasas la/ tsak+ṣur ban+dhās mig dar 'ching / ā khaṃ gis me tog gtad la/ sgo ma bzhi dang / 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi byin/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho sid+dha badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas nang gi sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal phul te/ bla ma sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ nang gi 'jug pa la/ slob dpon gyi rdo dril 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor la phyogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas sogs gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas khrid par bsam zhing / hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod nang du zhugs/ slob dpon gyi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod de/ dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/ shar sgo ru gnas pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ phyag bya/ dam tshig bsgrag pa dkyil chog bzhin/ sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la zhes pa nas/ bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung gi bar gyis sdom pa bzung bar khas blangs/

bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa kun/ /nas/ byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sdig bshags/ rjes su yi rang sems bskyed pa rnams byas nas/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ sogs kyis sdom pa bzung ba dngos rnams bya'o/ /ye shes dbab pa la/ dam bzhag bzhi dkyus bzhin/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /sogs gsum gyi gsol ba btab slob ma rnams skad cig gis/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me dpung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis phur pa 'gril zhing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs bzhi bgrad pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu sogs 'byung ba bskyed pa kye rdo rje ltar byas la/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pa slob ma'i rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas/ de g.yos rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar/ long bu'i rtsa nas zhugs/ sum mdor 'dres pas/ gzhir gnas kyi me 'bar bas snying kha'i sa sros/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ spyi bo'i rlung g.yos/ thur du bus pas/ mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma/ snying kha'i sa la thim pas/ bde ba dang / lte ba'i me 'bar bas drod skyes nas/ bde drod 'dzom pa la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying kha dang / mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams las/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma mdog dkar mo pu shud kyi mgo bo can/

lcags kyu dang / phur pa thogs pa mang por spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab par spyan drangs slob ma'i rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis thur du mnan nas lus bar snang du 'dar yer yer gnas pa'i spyi bo dang / ba spu'i bu ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu gul gyis bdug cing / rol mo sgra drag tu byas te/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ staṃ bha ya staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sogs brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya/ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hos me tog dor/ /sngon gyi mig mkhan sogs kyis gdong dbye/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sogs kyis me tog mgor bzhag mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas/ ye shes kyi mig thob ste/ thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar mos shig he badz+ra pā sh+ya dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos sogs kyis blta bar bskul nas/ srung 'khor/ dur khrod/ /gzhal yas khang gdan bcas/ gtso bo nas/ dam can gyi bar tshig gis ngo sprad/ rnam dag brjod pa dkyil chog bzhin bya/ de ltar na 'jug pa rnam pa gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs pas/ lam lnga las tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbang dngos la bzhi las dang po bum dbang la/ slob ma dang / slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi dbang po la rigs lnga dang / bdag po'i dbang dang drug las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon dam pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa lan gsum byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/

seng ge'i khri pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la/ slob ma rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu gong bzhin bskyed pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug slob dpon dang / dkyil 'khor las/ khro bo mang po spros/ bgegs bskrad par bsams la/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo bya zhing / kī la ya brjod/ slob ma dang / dbang rdzas/ las bum gyi chu dang / a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā wa sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi rnam shes kyi phung po dang / rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyi ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par a/ thugs khar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa ma dza: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li/ puṣ+pe/ dhūṣ+pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi t+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ ut+ta pha la ya bi pū ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ sogs kyis bstod la/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha slob dpon dang bcas pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ hūm̐ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing sogs kyis dbang bskur/

sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra ā ha ra sogs kyis mchod/ rol mo bya/ rtogs pa bskyed pa rnams kye rdor bzhin bya/ de bzhin du rig pa'i dbang gzhan rnams dkyil chog bzhin rigs sgres la shes par bya'o/ /bdag po'i dbang la/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ hūm̐ las gtso bo'i skur bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / thod pa a las/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pa/ lag pa g.yas g.yon du byin zhing / shes rab pad+ma'i sogs sngags bcas brjod/ de ltar na dbang rnam pa drug sogs kyis rtogs pa bskyed/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang la/ man+ḍal/ gsol gdab/ rdo dril swa bhā was sbyangs/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dril bu a las rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug 'od du zhu ba'i rdo dril du gyur pa/ lag pa g.yas g.yon du byin zhing / slob ma gtso bo yab yum gyi skur gsal ba la/ thabs mchog ye shes sogs brjod la/ rdo rje thugs kha dang dril bu dku g.yon du brten la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ sogs dang / a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag soms kyi rdo dril gyi de kho na nyid brjod la/ don bshad/ yang rdo dril snying khar bsnol nas 'dzin du bcug la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ sogs dang / rdo rje che dang sogs brjod/ ngo sprad cing / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ sogs kyis bum chus dbang bskur/ mi bskyed pa he ru kas gtso bo mdzad pa'i khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan la/ lha thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas par mos la/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog tor/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra ā ha ra lisogs kyis mchod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/

slob dpon gyi thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gis mthar kī la yas bskor ba dang / slob ma'i snying kha yang de 'dra ba bsgom la/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ de'i thugs kha nas sngags phreng byung ba zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying kha'i sngags phreng la thim par mos na/ kī la ya'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs brjod cing slob mas me tog 'thor/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'das 'di la sogs brjod nas/ me tog spyi bor bzhag pas brtan par bsam mo/ /de nas rigs lnga'i rjes gnang dang / dung sbyin pa sogs nas/ rten 'brel 'grig go'i bar dkyil chog bzhin/ gnyis pa gsang dbang la/ man+ḍal gsol btab/ slob mas rig ma phul te/ khyed zhabs sogs tshigs bcad dang / 'bru gsum brjod la/ gdong bcing / bdud rtsi gtor nas/ slob dpon gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs la/ zhal du zhugs/ 'od du zhu nas yum gyis mkhar babs pa'i byang sems lce thog tu bzhag par mos nas/ bdud rtsi byin zhing / byang chub sems kyi sogs dang / slob mas a ho ma hā su kha brjod nas/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam ste/ nga ni sangs rgyas sogs dang / rtogs pa bskyed pa/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod rnams dkyus bzhin/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes la maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba btab/ gdong bcing / rig ma gtad pa/ dri ba dris lan sogs nas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes pa'i bar dang / gdong phye/ rtogs skyed gzhung bzhin/ bzhi pa la maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ gdong bcing / ji ltar snang ba sogs nas rten 'brel 'grig go'i bar dang / gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ sogs kyis dam tshig bsgrags nas/ bdag gi lus kyang bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar dkyil chog bzhin bya'o/ /de nas tshogs dbul ba sogs gong bzhin byas la/

gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel mar byed na/ nub dang po rnams la mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlab nas/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod gsol rnams sta gon bzhin byas pa'i rjes la/ brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol/ go bgo ba smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya/ nub tha ma la phyi rol du phyogs skyong gi gtor ma sngar bzhin btang la/ nang du 'ong nas/ mchod bstod sogs gong bzhin dang / dkyil 'khor gyi brten pa lha'i tshogs rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor bum pa'i lha/ gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol byas te/ bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ ras bris la brten pa'i dbang du byas na sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi/ dang po ni ras la sogs pa'i gzhi gtsang ma la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar/ mchod gtor gong bzhin bshams la/ sngon 'gros sa slang ba'i skabs ltar/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo ba/ rnga byin dbab/ dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa/ dbang bskur rgyas btab pa yan sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gang rung skabs dang bstun nas byed/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon gong gi sa byin rlabs bzhin byas la/ sa'i lha mo'i maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor rnams bsal nas/ lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bdun cu don lnga bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbus su bzhag la/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon/ rjes chog rnams gong bzhin bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sngar gyi sar ras bris bkram/ mchod gtor bshams nas/ tho 'dzugs sogs grub na byed/ ma byas kyang rung / sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas mchod dang / rnga byin dbab nas bzung / bzlas pa'i bar rgyas 'bring gang rung byas la/ phyogs gtor btang / bdag 'jug rdzogs par blang ngo / slob ma yod na dbang bskur ba yang bya/ rjes chog gzhan rnams gong bzhin las/ ras bris la brtan bzhugs bya/

nub phyi ma la lhag ma rgyas pa btang zhing / bsrung gtor/ bstan ma'i gtor ma rnams khang stengs su phul nas smon lam bkra shis sogs rgyas pa bya'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa'i lam/ /gzhan las ches lhag brgyud pa'i srol/ /tshul 'dir zhugs na 'di phyi'i don/ /'bad med myur du 'grub byed yin/ /de lta'i chos tshul zab mo 'di/ /rgyun du mi nyams rgyas pa'i phyir/ /smin byed dbang gi cho ga yi/gsal byed rin chen do shal 'di/ /rnam par bsgrubs pa'i dge ba gang / /bsil zer byed pa lta bu des/ /'gro ba'i gdung ba kun bsal nas/ /ye shes rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog de ltar rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rtogs par sla ba zhes bya ba/ chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa las cung zad mi gsal ba rnams/ bla ma rnams kyi gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin/ blo gros dman pa rnams kyi don du/ chos tshul 'di la dad cing 'dun pa'i gshin rje du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ /dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos brī bhū mi paṇ+ḍu mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kī r+t+ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre ṇa 'bru mang ces pa sa pho stag lo gro zhun zla ba'i dkar phyogs/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus phyogs kyi tshes la dpal snar thang gi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rat+na pradz+nyas bgyis so/ /'dis snyigs ma'i dus kyi gdul bya/ skal bar ldan pa rnams la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //maṅgalaṃ shu bhaṃ/ /mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ /e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i gsal byed rin po che'i do shal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
